definitions.gloss: to operate; to control; to handle (a machine or device)
definitions.explanation: To use the controls of a machine, device, or software to make it function. The most common everyday usage.

definitions.gloss: to manipulate; to rig; to tamper with
definitions.explanation: To unfairly influence data, information, or people for one's own purposes. Carries a negative connotation.

notes:
{操作|そうさ}する covers two clearly related senses: physically operating a device (literal) and manipulating opinions, prices, or events behind the scenes (figurative).

USAGE:
- A transitive ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb. The noun ⟦{操作|そうさ}→操作：03316_sousa⟧ appears in many compounds.
- Sense 1 (operating a device) is one of the most common verbs for using any machine, computer, or app.
- Sense 2 (manipulation) carries a strongly negative connotation of underhanded control.
- Note the homophone ⟦{捜査|そうさ}→捜査：03688_sousa⟧ ('criminal investigation'), which is written with different kanji.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{操作|そうさ}する: to operate a machine
- ⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{操作|そうさ}する: to operate a computer
- ⟦{操作|そうさ}→操作：03316_sousa⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧: how to operate (a standard manual heading)
- ⟦{操作|そうさ}→操作：03316_sousa⟧⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧: operation/control screen
- ⟦{操作|そうさ}→操作：03316_sousa⟧⟦ミス→ミス：00285_misu⟧ / {誤|ご}⟦{操作|そうさ}→操作：03316_sousa⟧: an operational error / accidental misuse
- ⟦{世論|よろん}→世論：16145_yoron⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{操作|そうさ}する: to manipulate public opinion
- ⟦{株価|かぶか}→株価：05154_kabuka⟧⟦{操作|そうさ}→操作：03316_sousa⟧: stock-price manipulation
- ⟦{遠隔|えんかく}{操作|そうさ}→遠隔操作：20454_enkakusousa⟧: remote operation/control

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{扱|あつか}う→扱う：01862_atsukau⟧: to handle, to use (broader and more casual).
- ⟦{動|うご}かす→動かす：01885_ugokasu⟧: to move, to operate (more physical, less technical).
- ⟦{制御|せいぎょ}→制御：11816_seigyo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to control (often technical/automated).
